_doc: Wilderness set pieces, round 5: props of the Silver Run fish hatchery (w5_fish_hatchery), a state trout hatchery on a forest creek the Cordon used as a water-testing post. Models: tools/assetgen/blender/generators/props_wild5_hatchery.py -> models/props/<id>[_worn|_destroyed].glb; catalog tools/assetgen/blender_catalogs/props_wild5_hatchery.py. Materials: shared sets plus w5_hatchery_trout (materials/props_wild5_hatchery.json). size = [width x, height y, depth z] in metres (Godot axes, front +Z); PoiBuilder's collision box is the size centred over the origin. Floor props stand on their origin with their depth centred on it; the sample board hangs with its origin on the wall plane.

defs.name: Concrete Raceway
defs.description: A 5 m section of poured concrete raceway, 1.8 m wide and waist deep: thick walls with a chamfered cap, keyway slots for the dam boards at both ends, a screen frame and the water to within a hand of the top. Clean: still green water and the last of the trout belly up along the screens. Worn: the water furred over from wall to wall with white Bloom felt, capped with fruiting heads along the walls. Low enough to vault.

defs.name: Raceway Headbox
defs.description: The concrete headbox along the head of the raceways: a covered channel fed by the intake pipe, three gate valves with handwheels letting water down into the raceways through splash boards, and a galvanised cover with a feed scoop left on it (worn: the cover off one bay, Bloom felt in the channel).

defs.name: Shed Post
defs.description: A creosoted timber post on the pony wall of an open-sided shed, carrying the top plate a metre each way under the eave with two knee braces (worn: a brace split off and hanging). Collision is the post alone; the plate is overhead.

defs.name: Intake Pipe
defs.description: A 600 mm riveted steel intake pipe on concrete saddles: a bellmouth and trash screen at the dam end, a gate valve with a handwheel on a stand, and an elbow down through the shed's pony wall into the headbox (worn: rust-streaked, the screen choked with leaves and white growth).

defs.name: Fish Tote
defs.description: A grey plastic fish tote on a pallet with a dip net across it, full of dead trout packed in melted ice (worn: the fish furred white, spores dusting the rim and the pallet).

defs.name: Feed Cart
defs.description: A galvanised feed cart on two wheels and a caster: a hopper of pelleted fish feed with a hinged lid, a scoop on a chain and the day's feeding weights chalked on its side (worn: the lid off, the feed caked and green).

defs.name: Incubator Stack
defs.description: A vertical-flow egg incubator: eight shallow green fibreglass trays in a stainless frame, the supply line and valve at the top and the drain spout at the foot (worn: trays furred white, the water off; destroyed: the frame racked over and half the trays pulled out across the floor).

defs.name: Hatching Trough
defs.description: A long shallow aluminium hatching trough on a steel stand, divided into baskets with perforated bottoms, a supply pipe with a valve at the head and a standpipe drain at the foot (worn: the baskets empty and filmed white, a sample jar left in one).

defs.name: Sample Board
defs.description: A whiteboard screwed to the wall with the Cordon's sampling grid ruled on it in marker: stations down the side, the hours across, a red cross in nearly every square (worn: smeared, the bottom rows wiped with a hand).

defs.name: Water Chiller
defs.description: A packaged water chiller against the wall: a louvred steel cabinet with the compressor and condenser fans, insulated supply and return lines up to the ceiling, a dial thermometer and a red isolator switch (worn: a fan guard off, the lines sweating rust).

defs.name: Sample Coolers
defs.description: Two white sample coolers stacked on a third, each strapped shut and taped with a Cordon chain-of-custody label (worn: the top one open and empty, its ice packs on the floor).

defs.name: Feed Pallet
defs.description: A pallet of pelleted trout feed in 20 kg paper sacks, stacked six courses high and stretch-wrapped (worn: the wrap slit, the top sacks torn open and the pellets spilled).

defs.name: Intake Weir
defs.description: A small concrete weir across the creek: an 8 m wall with a notched spillway and the water sheeting over it, wing walls into both banks, a stone apron below, the east abutment wide enough for the intake gate, and two steel legs carrying the catwalk's landing over the bank (worn: moss and white film on the lip). Its collision is the wall and the abutment under the POI's kit catwalk.

defs.name: Weir Pool
defs.description: The pool the weir holds back: still brown water at waist height between dry-laid stone banks, a boulder riffle where the creek comes in and lily pads in the slack water (worn: white scum in the corners). No collision: waded through.

defs.name: Creek Bed
defs.description: 8 m of shallow forest creek: a water ribbon over a cobble bed, mossy stones and gravel bars along both banks and a snag or two (worn: a scum of white spores in the eddies). Walked through: no collision.

defs.name: Intake Headgate
defs.description: The intake gate's lifting stand on the catwalk: a cast-iron pedestal, a geared handwheel and the threaded stem down through the deck to the gate (worn: the wheel chained and padlocked by the Cordon).

defs.name: Water Sampler
defs.description: A Cordon automatic water sampler: a grey hard case on its legs with the pump, a carousel of bottles under the lid, a battery box, a little solar panel on a pole and the intake hose over the rail into the weir pool (worn: the panel cracked, the hose cut).

defs.name: Catwalk Railing
defs.description: 1 m of galvanised pipe railing with a knee rail and a toe board, along the open edge of the intake catwalk (worn: the knee rail sagging, the toe board split).

defs.name: Hatchery Sign
defs.description: A routed cedar sign between two peeled log posts under a little shingled cap: a carved rainbow trout leaping over painted ripples (worn: the paint gone grey, a corner split, the Cordon's orange quarantine tape wound round one post).

defs.name: Fish Stocking Truck
defs.description: A state fish stocking truck: a green cab-over with a flatbed carrying two insulated aluminium fish tanks, their aerators, oxygen bottles in a rack and the release chutes folded at the back (worn: tyres flat, a window out, the tank lids open and white inside).

defs.name: Feed Silo
defs.description: A galvanised bulk feed bin on four legs: a ribbed tank, a conical hopper with the auger boot underneath, a ladder up the side to the lid and the feed line running off to the raceways (worn: streaked, the lid hanging open).
